long_term_goal: GPT-grade general language understanding without an external LLM reasoning dependency
implemented: bounded temporally versioned epistemic ledger in conversation state
belief records linked to source proposition referents
subject, state-axis, state-value, polarity, and temporal proposition signatures
typed reaffirmation, contradiction, supersession, and retraction revision edges
marked same-source update versus unmarked same-source conflict distinction
cross-source contested beliefs without truth selection
explicit correction including unknown-state fallback to latest same-source claim
retraction-driven removal from active reference state
automatic conflict reconciliation after one side becomes inactive
past, present, future, and unspecified temporal anchors
source-specific retrieval of older concurrent active claims

architecture.revision_path: proposition referent -> local semantic signature -> active-record comparison -> typed revision edge -> source-aware reference state
architecture.authority_path: belief record -> dialogue-local provenance only -> no truth or execution authority

non_gating_all_features_observation.cause: semantic-reasoning includes SEM-26 types through two module identities under the all-features combination

development_counterexamples.observed: Correction-predicate complementizer that was treated as a demonstrative reference.
development_counterexamples.repair: Extended grammatical complementizer context to typed correction predicates.

development_counterexamples.observed: Korean document provenance with 에 따르면 fell through to a request speech act.
development_counterexamples.repair: Prioritized valid goal-free attribution as Inform before legacy request cues.

development_counterexamples.observed: Each new proposition turn discarded all older proposition referents.
development_counterexamples.repair: Retained concurrent active propositions and delegated deactivation to typed ledger status.

development_counterexamples.observed: The state token 비활성 could be consumed by the shorter positive token 활성.
development_counterexamples.repair: Selected the longest matching local semantic state marker.

development_counterexamples.observed: A remaining side stayed contested after the opposing record was retracted.
development_counterexamples.repair: Reconciled contested records and removed stale unresolved-conflict entries after every turn.

known_limits: State opposition is based on a compact local semantic-axis vocabulary rather than open-domain entailment.
Temporal anchors are coarse past, present, future, or unspecified categories rather than exact intervals.
Event time, report time, recurring states, and interval overlap are not represented.
Source reliability and evidential strength are not calibrated or learned.
Nested modality, uncertainty, counterfactual belief, and generalized quantifier scope remain incomplete.
Pronoun-based and long-distance actor continuity is not general.
The ledger has no transactional durable snapshot, import, or rollback protocol yet.
No broad open-domain corpus, human calibration study, or frontier-model comparison has been run.
The system remains below GPT-grade breadth, robustness, knowledge, and calibration.
next_frontier: nested modal, uncertainty, negation, counterfactual, and quantifier scope
attribution-aware question answering that distinguishes report from fact
exact temporal relations and event-time versus report-time representation
evidence aggregation and source reliability without semantic authority promotion
long-distance actor and belief-holder reference resolution
transactional ledger snapshots with validation, import, and rollback
larger family-held-out adversarial dialogue suites with calibrated abstention
